baseline.conditions: Freight approach has public and raider-controlled branches.

title: A road with competing stories
daily_life: Stonewake’s freight approach reaches Cinder Cuts, where families remember lost work and outsiders often remember only raiders. Both lawful households and coercion exist in the district.
timing: Nine days is the base route. Public and raider-controlled branches are not interchangeable. A paid passage on one branch does not establish safe access to the other.
handoff: Record which branch a witness actually saw. A yard document cannot certify the whole inhabited district, and a district name does not make every resident an accomplice.
story_option: A stolen load carries a legitimate repair tag from an innocent workshop. Pursuing the tag without asking when the repair occurred threatens the wrong household.
production: Civilian terraces remain distinct from Ashmouth Freight Yard. Travel shots should include inhabited life before the later crime location, without revealing writer-only villains early.
direction: Listed a-to-b planning reference; reverse passage requires a fresh itinerary.
geometry: Regional endpoints and route length inherited; connecting line is not a surveyed track.
